row: Paton & Lee Ltd Equine Veterinary Surgeons

Paton and Lee LLP Equine Veterinary Surgeons provide first class equine veterinary care throughout Essex and Suffolk. Our YouTube channel aims to educate, entertain and inform our clients and all other horse owners on the work we perform at our busy first-opinion equine practice.
